fields.summary_ko.0: Eli Lilly (NYSE: LLY) expands oncology research platform through acquisition of Calytrix Bio and precision cancer therapy collaboration with Stipple Bio, receiving a target price of $1,463.
fields.summary_ko.1: Pursuing 'Non-GLP-1 engine' strategy by investing revenue generated from GLP-1 cardio-metabolic drugs into next-generation areas including oncology and neuroscience.
